subject: [PATCH v5 5/9] mm/collapse: state what a collapse may do in the policy

2026-10-15.patch_summary: This patch modifies the collapse code in the Linux kernel to decouple its behavior from khugepaged by introducing a struct collapse_policy that callers can fill with their specific settings. The policy includes limits on missing, swapped-out, or shared PTEs for PMD-sized and smaller windows, as well as other parameters such as whether to look at used ranges and how to handle MADV_FREE'd pages. The patch also removes the need for khugepaged to start a collapse by having it fill its policy once per scan pass, and makes some minor changes to the code's behavior and performance.
